verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Identity Verification runs through Link with client-side callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess) and performs documentary verification. Nothing in the pack names native iOS, Android, or web SDKs, and nothing describes guided camera capture with glare, blur, or edge-detection coaching. Document authentication and liveness are adjacent capabilities, not capture guidance, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try
